tool_input.command:
$tempDir = "C:\Python313"
$zipPath = "$env:TEMP\python.zip"

Write-Host "Downloading embedded Python 3.13..."
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.13.0/python-3.13.0-embed-amd64.zip" -OutFile $zipPath -UseBasicParsing

Write-Host "Extracting to $tempDir..."
Expand-Archive -Path $zipPath -DestinationPath $tempDir -Force
Remove-Item $zipPath

Write-Host "Verifying Python installation..."
if (Test-Path "$tempDir\python.exe") {
    Write-Host "Python executable found!"
    & "$tempDir\python.exe" --version
} else {
    Write-Host "Python executable not found. Contents of $tempDir:"
    Get-ChildItem $tempDir | Select-Object -First 20
}
tool_input.description: Download and extract embedded Python using Expand-Archive
